pairsWith.noteUz: 3-4-unitlar (Shop till you Drop!, Days to Remember) bo'yicha nazorat testi: xarid qilish, qiyosiy daraja, past continuous, must/can't (taxmin), ob-havo va hikoya so'zlari.

scanNote:
PROGRESS TEST 2 - Units 3-4 (71-bet, PDF 66). Yuqorida to'q sariq 'PROGRESS TEST 2' va 'Units 3-4'. Katakchalar: NAME, CLASS, DATE, MARK, (Time: 20 minutes).

⚠ BET RAQAMI: Progress Test 1 69-betda, Test 2 71-betda - har testning orqa beti (70, 72 ...) bo'sh va skan qilinmagan (Beginner Workbook'dagidek). Demak PDF 65 dan boshlab PDF N = kitob N+4 ... aslida testlar orasida 1 bet tushib qoladi: PDF 65=69, 66=71, 67=73 ...

'Vocabulary & Grammar':
1) 'Fill in the missing words.' 1 This isn't exactly what I ...... in mind. 2 Susan was cleaning ...... Ann was doing the washing up. 3 How ...... going to Mario's? They serve delicious pizza there. 4 Her umbrella is red ...... a wooden handle. 5 She ...... be 16 years old. She looks older. 6 I can't wait to ...... shopping. 7 What ...... of cake would you like? 8 She was waiting ...... a taxi when it started raining. 9 Don't miss the ...... to go shopping in Milan. 10 "...... did you lose it?" "At the bus station." 11 "...... will that be?" "£10". 12 She's got fair hair. She ...... be from Sweden. 13 I'm ...... we haven't got any apples left. 14 She's the best student ...... her class. 15 This skirt is the ...... price as that one. 16 We had a great ...... at the party. 17 My new house is ...... bigger than my last one. 18 The sun was ...... brightly over the calm water of the lake. 19 ...... the firefighters arrive in time? 20 She gasped ...... amazement when she saw the diamond ring.
2) 'Choose the correct item.' 1 I'd like to ...... a bouquet of flowers please. A deliver B order C take. 2 Suddenly, there was a loud rumble of ...... . A lightning B rain C thunder. 3 This hat is cheaper ...... that one. A than B in C from. 4 Do you take ...... cards? A credit B prescription C cash. 5 That was the ...... film of all. A bad B worst C worse. 6 All his toys were ...... on the floor. A laying B lying C lied. 7 Small flower stalls line the ...... of the river. A chops B sales C banks. 8 This is the ...... famous department store in Paris. A most B more C much. 9 I could hear a siren ...... in the distance. A flashing B barking C wailing. 10 There's someone ...... on the door. A screeching B dripping C knocking.

'Communication':
3) 'Complete the dialogues.' 1 A: Excuse me - ......? B: This shirt? It's £45. 2 A: So, Mr Stuart ...... yesterday? B: There was a burglary next door. 3 A: I'd like some eggs, please. B: Certainly. ...... else? 4 A: ...... holiday? B: It was fantastic. 5 A: ...... look like? B: It's a brown plastic handbag with two yellow straps.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '71'.

exercises.explanationUz:
3-4-UNITLAR TAKRORI - 20 ta
  bo'shliq.

  Xarid iboralari: what I HAD in
    mind; What KIND of cake; HOW
    MUCH will that be?; I'm AFRAID
    we haven't got ...; the SAME
    price as; the CHANCE to go
    shopping; can't wait to GO
    shopping
  Past continuous: was cleaning
    WHILE Ann was doing; was
    waiting FOR a taxi; The sun was
    SHINING; DID the firefighters
    arrive?
  Taxmin: She MUST be 16 (ishonch);
    She MUST be from Sweden
  Qiyoslash: the best student IN
    her class; MUCH bigger than
  Boshqa: red WITH a wooden
    handle; a great TIME; gasped IN
    amazement; WHERE did you lose
    it?


⚠ 'HOW ABOUT GOING ...?':

  = ... borsak-chi? (taklif).


⚠ 'TO GASP IN AMAZEMENT':

  = hayratdan nafasi ichiga tushmoq.

items.textEn: This isn't exactly what I ___ in mind.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'have in mind' = ko'zda tutmoq; o'tgan zamon 'had'.

items.textEn: Susan was cleaning ___ Ann was doing the washing up.
How ___ going to Mario's? They serve delicious pizza there.
Her umbrella is red ___ a wooden handle.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'red with a wooden handle' = yog'och dastali.

items.textEn: She ___ be 16 years old. She looks older.
I can't wait to ___ shopping.
What ___ of cake would you like?
She was waiting ___ a taxi when it started raining.
Don't miss the ___ to go shopping in Milan.
"___ did you lose it?" "At the bus station."
"___ will that be?" "£10".
items.whyUz: ⚠ Javob narx → 'How much will that be?'

items.textEn: She's got fair hair. She ___ be from Sweden.
I'm ___ we haven't got any apples left.
She's the best student ___ her class.
This skirt is the ___ price as that one.
We had a great ___ at the party.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'have a great time' = vaqtni yaxshi o'tkazmoq.

items.textEn: My new house is ___ bigger than my last one.
The sun was ___ brightly over the calm water of the lake.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'The sun was shining brightly' - hikoya boshlanishi.

items.textEn: ___ the firefighters arrive in time?
She gasped ___ amazement when she saw the diamond ring.

exercises.explanationUz:
3-4-UNITLAR LUG'ATI VA
  GRAMMATIKASI.

  1 ORDER a bouquet = guldasta
    buyurtma qilmoq
  2 a rumble of THUNDER = momaqaldiroq
    gumburlashi
  3 cheaper THAN
  4 CREDIT cards
  5 the WORST film of all (orttirma)
  6 toys were LYING on the floor
    (lie - lying)
  7 the BANKS of the river = daryo
    qirg'oqlari
  8 the MOST famous (orttirma)
  9 a siren WAILING = sirena
    chinqirashi
  10 KNOCKING on the door = eshikni
    taqillatish


⚠ 'LIE' va 'LAY':

  lie - lying = yotmoq;
  lay - laying = qo'ymoq. 'toys were
  lying' - yotardi.


⚠ TOVUSh FE'LLARI:

  wail = chinqirmoq (sirena);
  screech = chiyillamoq (tormoz);
  drip = tomchilamoq; bark =
  vovullamoq; flash = yaltiramoq.

items.textEn: I'd like to ___ a bouquet of flowers please.
Suddenly, there was a loud rumble of ___.
This hat is cheaper ___ that one.
Do you take ___ cards?
That was the ___ film of all.
items.uz: Bu hammasidan eng yomon film edi.

items.textEn: All his toys were ___ on the floor.
Small flower stalls line the ___ of the river.
items.uz: Kichik gul do'konchalari daryo qirg'oqlari bo'ylab tizilgan.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'the banks of the river' = daryo qirg'oqlari.

items.textEn: This is the ___ famous department store in Paris.
I could hear a siren ___ in the distance.
There's someone ___ on the door.

exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBGA QARAB SAVOL TUZISh.

  1 'It's £45' → Excuse me - how
    much is this shirt?
  2 'There was a burglary' → what
    happened yesterday?
  3 'Certainly. ...?' → Anything
    else?
  4 'It was fantastic' → How was
    your holiday?
  5 'brown plastic handbag' → What
    does it look like?


⚠ 'A BURGLARY':

  = o'g'irlik (uyga kirib).


⚠ 'ANYTHING ELSE?':

  = yana biror narsa kerakmi?
  (do'konda).

items.textEn: A: Excuse me - ___?  B: This shirt? It's £45.
A: So, Mr Stuart ___ yesterday?  B: There was a burglary next door.
A: I'd like some eggs, please.  B: Certainly. ___ else?
A: ___ holiday?  B: It was fantastic.
A: ___ look like?  B: It's a brown plastic handbag with two yellow straps.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Ko'rinish tavsifi → 'What does it look like?'

patterns.formula: KIM + was/were + V-ing + while + KIM + was/were + V-ing
patterns.exampleEn: Susan was cleaning while Ann was doing the washing up.
patterns.exampleUz: Syuzan tozalayotganda Enn idish yuvayotgan edi.
patterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Past continuous - bir vaqtdagi ikki harakat.

patterns.exampleEn: She must be 16 years old. She looks older.
patterns.exampleUz: U 16 yoshda bo'lsa kerak. Kattaroq ko'rinadi.

patterns.formula: X is cheaper than Y / the same price as Y / much bigger than Y
patterns.exampleEn: This hat is cheaper than that one. This skirt is the same price as that one.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu shlyapa anavinisidan arzonroq. Bu yubka anavinisi bilan bir xil narxda.

patterns.formula: How much is this ...? / Anything else? / Do you take credit cards?
patterns.exampleEn: Excuse me - how much is this shirt? - It's £45.
